import html # Predefined template for displaying a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = ( "
\n" "

{subject}

\n" "

\n" "
" ) def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The heading of the blog post. description : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str The HTML string containing the escaped title and body. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. ValueError If either argument is an empty string after stripping whitespace. """ if not isinstance(subject, str): raise TypeError("subject must be a string") if not isinstance(description, str): raise TypeError("description must be a string") # Trim whitespace and ensure non-empty content subject_clean = subject.strip() description_clean = description.strip() if not subject_clean: raise ValueError("subject cannot be empty") if not description_clean: raise ValueError("description cannot be empty") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS subject_escaped = html.escape(subject_clean, quote=True) description_escaped = html.escape(description_clean, quote=True) # Format the blog post using the predefined template formatted_blog = BLOG_FORMAT.format( subject=subject_escaped, description=description_escaped ) return formatted_blog
